summary: In the still darkness of the hovercraft, only the humans are alive. Trinity says Neo's name; his eyes open and, as he reaches up to touch her, tears pour from her smiling eyes. She kisses him and 'it seems like it might last forever.' The scene then fades to black and fades in on a computer screen 'as in the opening,' its cursor 'beating steadily, waiting.' A phone rings, is answered, and the screen fills with a trace program. Neo's voice is heard (V.O.), addressing someone out there in the Matrix: he knows they are there and can feel them, imagines they can feel him too. As the racing columns of numbers lock into place, he declares he is 'done running. Done hiding,' and leaves whether he is 'done fighting' up to them. He says he believes they both want this world to change, that the Matrix can remain a cage or become a chrysalis, and that freedom comes from changing yourself, not your cage. The camera dives through the numbers toward a constellation of stars that is revealed to be the holes in a phone mouthpiece seen from inside, as Neo says he can't tell them how to get to the world of hope and peace, but that if they free their minds they'll find the way.

what_changes.before: A fugitive running and hiding within the Matrix.
what_changes.after: Resolved and self-possessed, no longer pursued or concealed, choosing to stand and address the machines directly.
what_changes.evidence: You won't have to search for me anymore. I'm done running. Done hiding. Whether I'm done fighting, I suppose, is up to you.

what_changes.before: Seeing only the Matrix's limits: 'its edges, its boundaries, its rules and controls, its leaders and laws.'
what_changes.after: Seeing 'another world. A different world where all things are possible,' a world of hope and peace beyond the cage.
what_changes.evidence: But now, I see another world. A different world where all things are possible. A world of hope. Of peace.

what_changes.before: Needing to be shown that freedom comes from within.
what_changes.after: Understanding and teaching that to be free you must change yourself, not your cage.
what_changes.evidence: That to be free, you cannot change your cage. You have to change yourself.

what_changes.before: Waiting over the still, tearless Neo in the darkness.
what_changes.after: Weeping with relief and joy as he wakes and reaches for her, then kissing him.
what_changes.evidence: Tears pour from her smiling eyes as he reaches up to touch her. And she kisses him; it seems like it might last forever.

event_hint.one_line: Neo wakes to Trinity in the hovercraft, then places a call into the Matrix to announce his freedom and offer the machines a choice.

uncertain: Who exactly answers the ringing phone on the Matrix side and whether Neo's audience is the machines, other plugged-in humans, or both.
Whether the hovercraft is moving, powered down, or in any particular state beyond 'still darkness.'

minds.wants: To call Neo back from death and, having done so, to hold the proof that he is really here and alive.
minds.feels: A flood of relief so overwhelming it breaks past her usual containment — she has just confessed love to a corpse (in the event just past) and now the impossible has reversed. The tears she can't stop are the residue of that vigil finally discharging.
minds.shows: A smile through tears, a kiss that 'might last forever.' She lets everything show here, in the dark, with only the two of them alive — the one place her guard is permitted to drop.
minds.basis: The summary states tears 'pour from her smiling eyes' the instant his eyes open at her voice, and that she kisses him. This follows ev-034, where she held his body, told the Oracle's prophecy of loving the One, and kissed him. The scene's 'still darkness, only the humans are alive' isolates the two of them, which is why her guard can fully fall.

minds.wants: Nothing yet in the waking moment but to reach her; then, in the voice-over, to be witnessed by the machines on his own terms — no longer prey, but a voice they must answer.
minds.feels: In the kiss: pure presence, the human anchor after dying. In the call: a newly settled certainty. The man who was shot and fled is gone; what speaks now has stopped being afraid of being found because he has chosen to be found.
minds.shows: To Trinity, only the reaching hand and the kiss — wordless, private. To the Matrix, a controlled, deliberate voice: 'I'm done running. Done hiding,' offering the cage-or-chrysalis choice. The gap between the two is the whole arc of the scene: the private resurrection enables the public declaration.
minds.basis: He reaches up to touch her and kisses her silently, then the scene cuts to his V.O. declaring 'You won't have to search for me anymore. I'm done running. Done hiding,' and reframing the Matrix from cage to chrysalis. The earlier event had him killed and revived; this is the first voice we hear from the revived man, and it is resolute rather than frightened.

connects_back: ev-034 — Trinity's vigil, confession of love, and kiss that revived Neo; her tears here are the discharge of that grief.
The hovercraft breach and EMP (sc-222, ev-034) — the 'still darkness, only the humans are alive' is the powered-down ship after the sentinels were killed, which is why Neo must make his call quickly.
sc-221 — Neo diving for the phone as Trinity signals 'Now!' and Morpheus turns the key; this scene resolves that exit attempt into his voice reaching out.
sets_up: ev-036 — Neo's broadcast message to the Matrix, the cage/chrysalis philosophy delivered directly to the machines and plugged-in minds.
ev-035 — The EMP and escape from the hovercraft; the private reunion with Trinity must happen before the ship is lost.
The new Neo who will enter the lobby (ev-037) — the 'done running, done hiding' resolve is the stance he carries into open confrontation.
dramatic_function: It converts the private miracle of resurrection into a public, philosophical stance: the intimate kiss in the dark is the emotional ground from which Neo's resolved, self-possessed voice can address the machines, so the scene bridges the personal (love, grief, rebirth) and the thematic (freedom as self-change) while mirroring the film's opening to mark how far Neo has traveled.
